title: Final platform: typed AI services and an enforceable release gate
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions

relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects final platform: typed ai services and an enforceable release gate with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance requires unit/API/RAG/agent/security/performance evidence, report completeness, compatible rollback, an architecture/sequence diagram and a reviewer-ready README.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: The final project integrates failure triage, GraphQL test candidates, RAG support and a safe automation assistant behind one authenticated service. The shared evaluation framework produces release evidence from the same synthetic data, avoiding disconnected demonstrations that cannot be compared or replayed.
The portfolio result must be reproducible from the supplied synthetic fixtures and declared configuration. Keep a deterministic baseline visible alongside any live-provider results.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Expose typed endpoints, provider adapters, retrieval, tool policy and evaluation as separate domain modules. Add Docker/Compose, bounded jobs, portable traces and JSON/HTML reports. Use a release manifest linking dataset, code, prompt, model, index, image and evaluation artifacts.
The repository labs provide the domain entry points and fixture cases. Run the acceptance checks before recording project completion and keep the generated run ID in your field notes.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: Run the entire failure matrix: provider timeout, malformed response, stale index, forbidden tool, poisoned document and load pressure. Verify visible degraded states, no secrets in reports and a nonzero release exit when any required case is missing or fails.
Trace the actual effect and retain the counterexample as a regression fixture. Fixing presentation alone does not establish that the application boundary is safe.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
